note: What each finished fixture actually carries, read back from its own bytes. The finalizer's report says what this build believes it wrote; this says what the paper shows.

artifacts.proofMethod: AcroForm fill: every value is set on the document's own widget and its appearance is generated by the form, and the form is then flattened, so the delivered file carries no annotation layer and every mark it makes is a form XObject drawn by a page. The counts below are read back from the finished PDF by two independent readers of those bytes -- pdf-flattened-widgets.mjs at each field's own measured /Rect, and rcap-output-glyph-reading.mjs composing each appearance's CTM against the pinned source's widget rectangles. Neither is this build's intent and none is a literal.
artifacts.addedGlyphsNote: Read from the delivered bytes by rcap-output-glyph-reading.mjs: every glyph shown by every operand of every show-text operator in every flattened widget appearance this build drew. It is not asserted from the fill strategy, and it is not the count of scanned page images the source itself ships.
